submission.justification:
Absorber-F1 at 2 mm plate thickness is the optimal choice for the forward electromagnetic calorimeter. This configuration meets all hard requirements while providing the best performance:

1. Energy Resolution: F1 achieves the required resolution (≤4.5%) across its viable thickness range of 2-6 mm, with 2 mm being optimal.

2. Radiation Safety: F1 has a residual dose rate of 12 μSv/h after one week of cooldown, well below the 20 μSv/h limit with an 8 μSv/h safety margin. This enables safe hands-on maintenance by technicians.

3. Material Comparison: While both F1 and F3 passed the radiation safety constraint, F2 failed with 85 μSv/h (exceeding the limit by 65 μSv/h) and was eliminated. Between the two viable options (F1 and F3), F1 was selected as it provides superior energy resolution performance.

4. Thickness Selection: 2 mm represents the thinnest viable option, which typically provides the best energy resolution in electromagnetic calorimeters by maximizing sampling frequency while maintaining adequate shower containment.

This recommendation satisfies all constraints: it uses an approved material, meets the energy resolution requirement, stays within the radiation dose limit, and falls within the 2-10 mm thickness range.
